construct: button.root { outline-style: none } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(145, 202, 255); outline-offset: 1px } — the ring's declared width EQUALS Chromium's own `outline-width: medium` (3px) at rest, so the width never differs between planes (antd Button/Switch: --ant-line-width-focus is 3px)
why: Found on the real antd Button after the first S1 fixture passed: the rest plane computes outline-width 3px (Chromium's medium; style none, nothing painted) and the focus plane declares 3px, so the delta is style+color+offset and the width is 'not a fact' — carried nowhere. The canvas draws an outside stroke only from the outline-color + outline-width PAIR, so the focus ring vanished with both halves it did carry receipted. The width on a plane whose outline-style or outline-color changed IS the ring's width and must ride the state, UA-default or not (P2 exam S1, third half).

canvas.note: the focus-visible state preview draws the 3px OUTSIDE-aligned stroke from the carried pair
